classification.scope: Repository-only DATA-02 successor checkpoint identity and scope binding.

implemented_contract: The caller independently pins source commit, release id and image digest; every checkpoint candidate coordinate must match exactly.

Dataset member counts remain distinct from covered asset counts, and the top-level Publication member count equals their exact sum.
Each dataset member count is at least its covered asset count; nonzero members cannot claim zero covered assets.
Four dataset keys and their publication ids and hashes remain exact and unique.
Historical v1/5,533 evidence remains immutable and fails closed under v2; it is not auto-upgraded.
The recorder remains offline and has no network, ORM or production-write path.
